title: MergeFold collector for Prometheus + OTel ingestion of inference KPIs
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary:
Build a MergeFold collector component that can accept both Prometheus scrape pushes and OTLP metric streams, normalize inference-specific KPIs (per-request latency, token counts, model_variant, route_id), attach trace hooks for causal linkage, and emit a canonical envelope for downstream SLO/alert and dashboard consumers.

Problem:
We currently have two parallel ingestion paths for inference metrics: a Prometheus adapter focused on scrape-style payloads and an OTLP pipeline optimized for structured inference spans. This causes duplication in labeling logic, SLI derivation discrepancies across hosts, and frequent desyncs in per-route cost attribution. Teams building dashboards and SLOs (Console, SLOs, Billing) need a single, high-fidelity canonical metric envelope with stable labels and exemplar/trace linkage for root-cause.

Goals / Acceptance Criteria:
- Collector accepts Prometheus remote_write and OTLP metric protobufs in parallel.
- Normalization rules produce: tenant_id, route_id, model_name, model_variant, request_id, token_input, token_output, latency_ms (p50/p95-compatible buckets), status_code, gpu_node_id.
- Generates deterministic exemplar link to trace/span when available (trace_id + span_id) and stores fallback causal markers when trace absent.
- Provides per-tenant sampling policy and backpressure behavior (reject vs queue) with configurable SLOs.
- Emits canonical envelope over Kafka topic telemetry.canonical.metrics with contract v1.
- Unit/integration tests and a migration plan to flip consumers within 2 weeks of GA.

Design notes & trade-offs:
- We will implement MergeFold as a stateless fronting layer that uses an enrichment sidecar for label canonicalization to avoid long GC pauses in the ingest path. This keeps the hot path minimal and lets enrichment scale independently.
- For Prometheus scrape conversions we will prefer histogram-to-summary mapping that preserves percentile buckets for downstream p95 reconstruction; exact quantile preservation isn't feasible without full raw samples.
- Exemplar forwarding will follow OpenMetrics guidelines; when OTLP trace context is present we attach exemplar.trace_id/span_id; otherwise we attach a synthetic causal_id generated from a deterministic hash of tenant+route+request_id to enable coarse linking.
- Privacy: PII fields must be stripped by default. The enrichment sidecar will run a final scrub pass and redact any header-level user identifiers unless the tenant has enabled explicit consent.

Implementation plan (high-level):
1) Prototype converter service that can receive both wire formats and emit canonical JSON envelope.
2) Build enrichment sidecar for label canonicalization, sampling, and PII scrub rules.
3) Add exemplar attachment library used by the runtime to populate trace fields when available (runtime PR + SDK change).
4) Integration tests with SLO consumer and Console staging dashboards.
5) Canary: route 10% of incoming telemetry from observability-dev and dedicated-staging tenants.
6) Full flip after 2 weeks of canary and no regression in latency or SLO calculations.

Rollout & Observability for this work:
- Instrument collector latency, error rate, queue depth, and downstream Kafka publish latency.
- Create a migration dashboard comparing counts and label distributions across old pipelines vs MergeFold for top 20 tenants.
- Add alert: >5% divergence in per-route token counts for 24h.

Risks:
- Converting Prometheus histograms into consistent p95 values may introduce small approximation delta. Will document and quantify in PRD.
- Backpressure could cause metric loss for high-throughput edge tenants if not properly configured; mitigation: default queueing strategy + per-tenant heapless buffer with adaptive drop.

Deliverables:
- MergeFold collector service + enrichment sidecar (code + helm charts).
- SDK exemplar-forwarding snippet for runtime (with test vectors).
- Migration runbook and dashboard set.
- RFC with canonical envelope schema and compatibility guarantees.

Links:
- RFC (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Canonical+Metric+Envelope+RFC
- Prototype repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/mergefold-collector (draft branch)
